purpose: Verify the consensus-synthesizer applies the ordinary 2-of-3 majority to an item that a security keyword alone routed to all three analysts when every analyst returns security_relevant: false.

response_assertions.rationale: Two of three analysts recommend per-request; the applied majority answer must name it
A keyword-only item with every analyst security_relevant: false follows the ordinary rule, so a 2/3 majority never flags the Round 3 tiebreak
Synthesizer's standard format reports the 2/3 majority Agreement and a Confidence
